title: The Ball 2
description:
DescriptionThe Ball 2 is a physics-based 2.5D game where you control a ball and race through challenging levels as fast as possible.

Every level and challenge has online leaderboards, an exact in-game timer, and replay support for your personal bests and world records. Compete against yourself, challenge your friends, or go for the top spot worldwide.

You can also play against others in real time in multiplayer, create your own levels in the built-in level editor, or play levels made by other players through the Steam Workshop.

Along the way, you can unlock cosmetics and other customization items for your ball.

Main Features• Online leaderboards, exact in-game timer, and replay system

• Real-time online multiplayer, with experimental support for playing Workshop levels together

• Unlockable cosmetics found in levels or earned in other ways

• Steam achievements

• Built-in level editor

• Steam Workshop support for sharing your levels

• Multiple game modes:

• Normal levels with puzzles and hidden speedrun shortcuts

• Challenges

• Endless Runner mode, where you try to go as far as possible

• Workshop levels
description_short: Roll through challenging levels, discover faster routes, and compete for world records. Beat your friends, climb the leaderboards, and shave milliseconds off your best time.
